title: B-2 bomber money diverted to illegal man-made UFO projects

tellings.quote: $2 billion for a B2 stealth bomber, it's probably costing less than 100 million to make it.

plain: The B-2 stealth bomber cost the US about $2 billion apiece, but each one probably cost less than $100 million to make, and the difference was quietly funnelled into illegal secret projects building man-made UFOs. That is the claim of the UFO activist Steven Greer, speaking with Michels in 2025; if true, it would mean a hidden budget sits inside one of the Pentagon's best-known weapons programmes.
